name: Bipin Patsani

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Bipin Patsani is an English-language poet from Odisha whose teaching career took him to Arunachal Pradesh. His collections include Voice of the Valley, published by Writers Workshop in 1993, and Another Voyage and Homecoming, both published in 2010. His work has appeared in Kavya Bharati and other literary journals, joining a long engagement with poetry to questions of culture and human conduct.

In “The Taste of Freedom”, freedom depends on compassion, honesty and shared responsibility. “GROWING BIG AND BEAUTIFUL” asks whether monuments and rituals are enough to sustain a civilisation, while “PRIDE AND ANIMOSITY” challenges the destruction of the past in the name of prestige. “GOD, A POETIC IMAGE” brings these concerns into a contemplative register, imagining a divine presence spacious enough to gather different symbols and forms of experience.
